description: Create the progress tracking system, settings screen, Firebase authentication, and finalize the app with proper resource files (strings, colors, drawables).
steps: Create progress screens in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/progress/: ProgressScreen.kt (overall stats, chart showing improvement over time, per-rule scores, streak counter), ProgressViewModel.kt (aggregates data from UserProgress table)

Create settings screen in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/settings/: SettingsScreen.kt (language toggle Uz/Ru/En, theme dark/light, clear progress, sign out, about), SettingsViewModel.kt

Create Firebase auth integration in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/auth/: LoginScreen.kt (email/password + Google sign-in button), RegisterScreen.kt, AuthViewModel.kt (handles Firebase Auth operations)
Create app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml with all UI strings in English (default)
Create app/src/main/res/values/colors.xml with the app color palette
Create app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml with Material3 theme references
Create app/src/main/res/drawable/ vector drawables: ic_microphone.xml, ic_lessons.xml, ic_practice.xml, ic_progress.xml, ic_home.xml, ic_settings.xml (simple vector paths)
Create a placeholder google-services.json at app/google-services.json with TODO comment for user to replace
Update README.md with complete project documentation: features, setup instructions (Android Studio, Firebase setup, OpenAI API key), architecture overview, screenshots placeholder, contributing guide
acceptance_criteria: Progress screen shows per-rule scores and overall improvement
Settings screen allows language and theme changes
Auth screens provide email/password login and registration
All string resources are defined for English (default) and Uzbek
Vector drawable icons exist for all navigation items
README.md provides clear setup instructions including Firebase and OpenAI configuration
google-services.json placeholder exists with instructions to replace
verification: Verify all resource XML files are well-formed
Verify strings.xml has entries matching all UI text used in Composables
Verify README.md has setup instructions for Firebase and OpenAI API key
Verify auth screens use Firebase Auth SDK methods
findings: All files created and verified: progress screen with overall stats/weekly activity/rule progress/recent results, settings screen with language/theme/notifications/API key/clear data, auth screens with login/register/Google sign-in/password reset, 10 vector drawable icons, adaptive launcher icon, colors.xml, themes.xml, strings.xml (English + Uzbek), google-services.json placeholder, NavGraph updated to use real composables, comprehensive README.md in Uzbek. All XML validated as well-formed. Cannot run gradle build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
